span.p:
Per layer, per token: 2 x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 bytes = 4.0 KiB
identical on every layer -- query-head count never enters this product

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: If all 48 layers were global: 192.0 KiB per token = 24.0 GiB at 128k context

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
As actually built: 12 global layers grow with context = 6.0 GiB at 128k
36 sliding layers are pinned at 512 tokens = 2.0 MiB each, 72 MiB total
about 6.1 GiB -- a 4x cut. Arithmetic from config, not a measurement.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Budget against the measured fast tier: at least 62 GiB at about 200 GB/s

span.p: Reference panel -- what fills the MLP slot

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
layer 0 only -- LagunaMLP, intermediate_size 12288
selected because mlp_only_layers names layer 0

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
layers 1 to 47 -- LagunaSparseMoeBlock
256 experts, top 10 chosen by sigmoid score, moe_intermediate_size 1024
plus an always-on shared expert of width 1024

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Units 2 to 12 -- layers 4 to 47 -- this same shape, 11 more times

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
G -- layers 4, 8, 12 ... 44 -- GLOBAL
48 query heads / 8 KV heads -- GQA group 6
attends every position, up to 1048576
YaRN RoPE, theta 500000, on 64 of 128 head dims

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S S S -- the three layers after each G -- SLIDING
72 query heads / 8 KV heads -- GQA group 9
sees only the most recent 512 tokens
plain RoPE, theta 10000, on all 128 head dims
